answer: The gate that works is social-graph flow limits: new accounts may only attest through a sparse social graph where each edge carries a limited flow, so one operator cannot fan out thousands of identities without the graph itself throttling them. One crystal per identity, no bulk discount, no shared shortcut; the glacier the system trusts is earned history, and the zenith of the design is that the tenth fake costs ten times the first instead of the same price again.
